title: Read a query input
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Read a query input. Visit /page?n=3.
introduction: FromQuery makes the source of an input clear. GET /page with no n uses 1.
learningObjectives: Read a query input with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Read a query input

blocks.text: FromQuery uses the URL input when present; otherwise the default parameter is 1.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Inputs from clients still need suitable limits.
